purpose: single confirmatory execution after implementation and regression testing
superiority_rule: For both competitors and both primary metrics: paired bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0 and one-sided Wilcoxon p < 0.05.
outer_test_policy: Each locked outer test is evaluated only after all training and internal selection for its dataset/repeat are complete.
rerun_policy: CONFIRMATORY_RUN_COMPLETED.json blocks any second execution in this package.
